displayedInputs.question: Two vehicles are 300 km apart and start traveling toward each other simultaneously at speeds of 60 km/h and 40 km/h, respectively. After how many hours will they be 50 km apart, before they have met? (Unit: hours)
An item has a cost price of 80 yuan and a profit rate of 25%. What is its selling price? (Unit: yuan)
An item marked at 200 yuan is sold at 80% of its marked price. What is its selling price in yuan?
An item marked at 150 yuan is sold at 90% of its marked price and still earns a profit of 35 yuan. Find its cost price (unit: yuan).
An item is sold at 80% of its marked price for 240 yuan, yielding a profit rate of 20%. Find its cost price (unit: yuan).
Plan A costs 20 yuan per month + 0.1 yuan/minute, while Plan B costs 0 yuan per month + 0.2 yuan/minute. For how many minutes of calls will the costs be equal? (Unit: minutes)
A phone plan has a monthly fee of 10 yuan plus a charge of 0.2 yuan per minute. What is the cost in yuan for 50 minutes of calls in a month?
Car rental Plan A costs 100 yuan per day plus 2 yuan/km; Plan B costs 50 yuan per day plus 3 yuan/km. How many km must be driven in a day for the two plans to cost the same? (Unit: km)
Plan A has a monthly fee of 30 yuan plus 0.1 yuan/minute; Plan B has no monthly fee and charges 0.15 yuan/minute. If someone makes 500 minutes of calls per month, which plan saves more money?

choices.C: The two plans cost the same

displayedInputs.question: Quickly moving a pen tip across paper leaves a line. This phenomenon illustrates that

choices.A: A moving line generates a surface
choices.B: A moving point generates a line
choices.C: A moving surface generates a solid
choices.D: A moving solid generates a surface

displayedInputs.question: Which of a line, a ray, and a line segment extends infinitely in both directions?
Which of the following statements about ray \(AB\) is correct?

choices.A: Its endpoint is \(B\), and it extends infinitely in the direction from \(B\) to \(A\)
choices.B: Its endpoint is \(A\), and it extends infinitely in the direction from \(A\) to \(B\)
choices.D: It can extend infinitely in both directions

displayedInputs.question: Four points \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), and \(D\) lie in that order on line \(l\). How many line segments have these points as endpoints?
Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.A: Line segment \(AB\) and line segment \(BA\) are different line segments
choices.B: Ray \(AB\) and ray \(BA\) are the same ray
choices.C: The length of a line can be measured
choices.D: Line \(AB\) and line \(BA\) are the same line

displayedInputs.question: There are 5 points in a plane, with no three on the same line. If a line is drawn through each pair of points, how many lines can be drawn?
Why does a carpenter need to fix only two points when snapping an ink line?

choices.A: The perpendicular segment is the shortest
choices.C: The line segment between two points is the shortest path
choices.D: Through a point outside a line, there is exactly one line parallel to the given line

displayedInputs.question: Which of the following phenomena can be explained by “two points determine a line”?

choices.A: Fixing a wooden strip to a wall with two nails
choices.B: Straightening a winding river channel to shorten the sailing distance
choices.C: Taking a straight path from the classroom doorway to the teacher's platform gives the shortest distance
choices.D: Measuring the perpendicular segment from the landing point to the takeoff line when recording a long jump

displayedInputs.question: There are 3 points in a plane that do not lie on the same line. If a line is drawn through each pair of points, how many lines can be drawn in total?
Straightening a winding road shortens the travel distance. The mathematical basis for this is

choices.A: The perpendicular segment is the shortest
choices.C: Supplementary angles of the same angle are equal
choices.D: The line segment between two points is the shortest path

displayedInputs.question: The distance between points A and B is 7 cm, and C is any point in the plane. What is the minimum value of \(AC+BC\), in cm?

Point C lies on segment AB, with \(AC=5\text{ cm}\) and \(CB=3\text{ cm}\). What is the length of AB, in cm?

The lengths of segments AB and CD are compared by superposition: point A is made to coincide with point C, and rays AB and CD point in the same direction. Point B then lies in the interior of segment CD (without coinciding with point D). What is the relationship between AB and CD?

Points A, B, and C lie on the same line, with \(AB=10\text{ cm}\) and \(BC=4\text{ cm}\). What is the length of AC, in cm? (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas, in any order.)
How many degrees are in a straight angle?
Ray OA rotates about its endpoint O. When the terminal side first forms a straight line with the initial side, the angle formed is called a
Which of the following statements about angle notation is correct?

choices.A: \(\angle AOB\) and \(\angle BOA\) represent two different angles.
choices.B: \(\angle O\) can be used regardless of how many angles there are at the vertex.
choices.C: \(\angle 1\) is an angle named using three uppercase letters.
choices.D: In \(\angle AOB\), the middle letter O represents the vertex of the angle.

Which of the following pairs of angles are complementary?
